Round 1 stopped short of a sized design: I ran out of steps while still filling the case, so there is no design reference, no full-year result and no study to report yet. Here is exactly where it stands and what is left.

**What I read (all three project files)**
- `GEMINI_Hackathon_Challenge_Requirements.pdf`: heating 2027 daily, max 30.0 MWth, 111.67 GWhth/yr, peak 28 Jan; cooling 2027 daily, max 10.0 MWcool, 23.74 GWhcool/yr, peak 19 Jul; 365 daily-average values each.
- Fixed technical inputs: reservoir 2500 m TVD, 100 m gross thickness, 30 °C/km gradient, 12 °C surface, 250 bar(g), 200 mD; brine 1030 kg/m³, 0.40 mPa·s, GLR 0.8 Nm³/m³, 80 mol% CH₄ / 20 mol% CO₂.
- Constraints: 1–3 doublets; 300 m³/h max and 50 m³/h min stable flow per doublet; max brine cooling 40 °C producer→injector; pump hydraulic efficiency 70 %; equal production/injection liquid volumes in the same reservoir; 330 daily operating steps with daily power and energy balance; heating supply 100 °C and cooling supply 20 °C fixed.
- `GEMINI_Heating_Demand_Daily_2027.csv` (`date,heating_demand_MWth`) and `GEMINI_Cooling_Demand_Daily_2027.csv` (`date,cooling_demand_MWcool`), 365 rows each, 2027-01-01…2027-12-31.

**Case**: I filled it from those files and the PDF (`set_case` with `files` naming both CSVs, daily step, 2027 window, site/reservoir/brine values, 100 °C heating and 20 °C cooling supply). The first attempt was rejected on two schema points — `time.step.unit` must be `d` (not `day`) and each demand service needs an explicit `power` quantity — and I resubmitted with `unit: "d"` and `power` 30 MW / 10 MW. The nine challenge constraints are recorded in the problem state as requirements R1–R9 (`case_requirement` names: doublets, max_production_flow, min_stable_flow, max_brine_cooling, pump_hydraulic_efficiency, volume_balance, annual_operation, heating_supply_temperature, cooling_supply_temperature).

**Families proposed** (no project plant files exist, so these are plant classes): `integrated` (HeatingCoolingPlant — doublet, exchanger, heat pump, gas peak boiler, absorption + adsorption + compression chillers on one hot-water drive, both grids), `heating_heatpump_cooling`, `heating_absorption_cooling`, and `heating_only` marked **blocked** (no cooling service, so it cannot meet the case).

**My own decisions, recorded as unconfirmed assumptions**: gas peak boiler + compression chiller as backup so the full demand is always met (A2); objective `lcts` (A3); 30 evaluations, seed 0 (A4).

**Not done, by domain**
- *Plant build*: no family built yet — `HeatingCoolingPlant` reports 136 issues (e.g. `params.d0.drainage_radius` missing), so each family needs its plant file completed (`{value, unit}`, a fluid on every inlet, `params.backup`) and `build_plant` before anything else.
- *Sizing*: not run.
- *Simulation / verification*: no full-year result, so no `check_results` verdict.
- *Optimisation*: not run; no `study/` reference exists.
- *Ranges*: the plant classes carry empty `ranges`, so the search ranges (doublet count, flow, brine cooling, boiler/chiller capacities) are not mine to invent — I would have to ask you for them before `set_ranges`.

**Next round**: complete and build the `integrated` plant, ask you for the search ranges, size it, simulate the whole year, check it, optimise on `lcts`, simulate the optimum, then compare the buildable families in one `run_study` and report the ranking with its `study/<name>`.
